<style>
  /* Hide the whole search filter area visually */
  .rm-SearchFilter,
  [class^="SearchProjectsFilter"],
  [class*=" SearchProjectsFilter"] {
    opacity: 0;
    width: 0 ;
    flex: 0 0 0 !important;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  /* Hide the refinement list block itself */
  [class^="RefinementList-"],
  [class*=" RefinementList-"] {
    opacity: 0;
  }
</style>
  
 <script>
(function () {
  const currentPath = window.location.pathname;
  const isEnglishPage =
    currentPath === '/english' ||
    currentPath === '/english/';
  const isSplitEnglishPage = currentPath.startsWith('/split/v1.0-en/');
  const isAtendimentoProject =
    currentPath === '/atendimento' ||
    currentPath === '/atendimento/' ||
    currentPath.startsWith('/atendimento/');
  const validPaths = ['/', '/english', '/english/'];

  if (!validPaths.includes(currentPath) && !isSplitEnglishPage && !isAtendimentoProject) {
    return;
  }

  const portugueseFilters = [
    "Checkout e Link de Pagamento",
    "Cielo E-commerce",
    "Conectores E-commerce",
    "Gateway de Pagamento",
    "Risco",
    "Split"
  ];

  const englishFilters = [
    "Checkout and Link de Pagamento EN",
    "Cielo E-commerce API EN",
    "Gateway API EN",
    "Risk Management EN",
    "Split",
    "Cielo E-commerce (EN)"
  ];

  const atendimentoFilters = [
    "Atendimento E-commerce Cielo"
  ];

  const splitEnglishPathPrefix = "/split/v1.0-en/";
  const filtersToKeep = isAtendimentoProject
    ? atendimentoFilters
    : isSplitEnglishPage
      ? ["Split"]
      : isEnglishPage
        ? englishFilters
        : portugueseFilters;

  const key = (s) => (s || "")
    .replace(/\u00A0/g, " ")
    .normalize("NFKD").replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, "")
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/[()\-–—[\]{}.,:;!?]/g, " ")
    .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
    .trim();

  const keepKeys = new Set(filtersToKeep.map(key));

  function setCheckboxState(input, shouldBeChecked) {
    if (!input) return;

    if (input.checked !== shouldBeChecked) {
      input.click();
      input.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true }));
      input.dispatchEvent(new Event("change", { bubbles: true }));
    }
  }

  function configureSearchFilters(root = document) {
    const filterAside =
      root.querySelector("aside.rm-SearchFilter") ||
      document.querySelector("aside.rm-SearchFilter");

    if (!filterAside) return false;

    const items = filterAside.querySelectorAll("li.rm-SearchFilter-list-item, ol li");
    if (!items.length) return false;

    items.forEach((item) => {
      const label = item.querySelector("label");
      const input = item.querySelector('input[type="checkbox"]');
      const textEl = item.querySelector(".Toggle-label");
      const text = key(textEl ? textEl.textContent : label ? label.textContent : "");

      if (!input || !text) return;

      const shouldKeep = keepKeys.has(text);

      item.style.display = shouldKeep ? "" : "none";
      setCheckboxState(input, shouldKeep);
    });

    return true;
  }

  function resultPathAllowed(anchor) {
    if (!isSplitEnglishPage || !anchor) return true;

    try {
      const url = new URL(anchor.getAttribute("href"), window.location.origin);
      return url.pathname === splitEnglishPathPrefix.slice(0, -1) ||
        url.pathname.startsWith(splitEnglishPathPrefix);
    } catch (_error) {
      return false;
    }
  }

  function configureSearchResults(root = document) {
    if (!isSplitEnglishPage) return false;

    const containers = root.matches?.("[class*='SearchResult'], [class*='SearchResults']")
      ? [root]
      : Array.from(root.querySelectorAll?.("[class*='SearchResult'], [class*='SearchResults']") || []);

    if (!containers.length) return false;

    let foundResultLink = false;

    containers.forEach((container) => {
      const links = container.querySelectorAll?.("a[href]") || [];

      links.forEach((link) => {
        const href = link.getAttribute("href") || "";
        if (!href || href.startsWith("#") || href.startsWith("mailto:") || href.startsWith("tel:")) {
          return;
        }

        const resultItem =
          link.closest("li") ||
          link.closest("article") ||
          link.closest("[class*='SearchResult']");

        if (!resultItem) return;

        foundResultLink = true;
        resultItem.style.display = resultPathAllowed(link) ? "" : "none";
      });
    });

    return foundResultLink;
  }

  function runWithRetries(root = document) {
    const started = Date.now();

    const attempt = () => {
      const filtersOk = configureSearchFilters(root);
      const resultsOk = configureSearchResults(root);
      const ok = isSplitEnglishPage ? (filtersOk || resultsOk) : filtersOk;
      if (ok) return;
      if (Date.now() - started > 10000) return;
      setTimeout(attempt, 200);
    };

    setTimeout(attempt, 700);
  }

  function observeSearchUi() {
    if (!document.body) {
      setTimeout(observeSearchUi, 50);
      return;
    }

    const observer = new MutationObserver((mutations) => {
      for (const mutation of mutations) {
        for (const node of mutation.addedNodes) {
          if (!(node instanceof HTMLElement)) continue;

          const searchContainer =
            node.matches?.("[class*='SuperHubSearch-container']")
              ? node
              : node.querySelector?.("[class*='SuperHubSearch-container']");

          const filterAside =
            node.matches?.("aside.rm-SearchFilter")
              ? node
              : node.querySelector?.("aside.rm-SearchFilter");

          const searchResults =
            node.matches?.("[class*='SearchResult'], [class*='SearchResults']")
              ? node
              : node.querySelector?.("[class*='SearchResult'], [class*='SearchResults']");

          if (searchContainer || filterAside || searchResults) {
            runWithRetries(searchContainer || filterAside || searchResults || document);
          }
        }
      }
    });

    observer.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
  }

  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
    observeSearchUi();
    runWithRetries(document);
  });
})();
</script>

class="SuperHubDoc-article3ArTrEavUTKg rm-Article rm-Guides-SuperHub"><header id="content-head"><div class="row clearfix"><div class="col-xs-9"><h1>Sobre a API E-commerce Cielo</h1><div class="excerpt"><div class="rm-Markdown markdown-body" data-testid="RDMD"><p>Venda mais online com a solução completa de pagamento da Cielo. Mais segurança, performance e conversão no seu e-commerce</p></div></div></div></div></header><div class="grid-container-fluid" id="content-container"><section class="content-body grid-75 "><div class="rm-Markdown markdown-body rm-Markdown markdown-body ng-non-bindable" data-testid="RDMD" style="margin-left:31px"><style>/*! tailwindcss v4.1.17 | MIT License | https://tailwindcss.com */
@layer theme, base, components, utilities;
@layer utilities;
</style><p>A API E-commerce é uma solução completa de pagamento da Cielo, que conta com uma integração flexível e modular, alta conversão e segurança nas transações.</p>
<p>Com a API E-commerce Cielo é possível vender usando os principais meios de pagamentos do e-commerce, como cartões de crédito e débito, Pix, e-wallets, QRCode e boletos.</p>
<p>Além disso, a API E-commerce tem diversas ferramentas que podem ajudar no aumento da conversão:</p>
<span aria-label="Expand image" class="img lightbox closed" role="button" tabindex="0"><span class="lightbox-inner"><img alt="Ferramentas disponiveis na API E-commerce" class="img img-align-center " height="auto" loading="lazy" src="https://files.readme.io/d8e7e17-cielo-e-comm-readme.png" title="" width="auto"/></span></span>
<h2 class="heading heading-2 header-scroll"><div class="heading-anchor anchor waypoint" id="compra-com-um-clique"></div><div class="heading-text">Compra com um clique</div><a aria-label="Skip link to Compra com um clique" class="heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor" href="#compra-com-um-clique"></a></h2>
<p>Facilite o pagamento para o seu cliente, por meio do armazenamento seguro dos dados do cartão (tokenização) e possibilite compras futuras mais rápidas e fáceis, sem a necessidade de preencher os dados novamente.</p>
<blockquote>
<p>Saiba mais em <a href="https://docs.cielo.com.br/ecommerce-cielo/docs/tokenizando-cartoes" target="" title="">Tokenizando cartões</a>.</p>
</blockquote>
<h2 class="heading heading-2 header-scroll"><div class="heading-anchor anchor waypoint" id="zero-auth"></div><div class="heading-text">Zero Auth</div><a aria-label="Skip link to Zero Auth" class="heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor" href="#zero-auth"></a></h2>
<p>Antes de enviar um pagamento para autorização junto ao banco emissor, <strong>verifique se o cartão é válido ou não</strong> , sem comprometer nenhum valor na fatura do seu cliente.</p>
<blockquote>
<p>Saiba mais em <a href="/docs/zero-auth" target="" title="" class="doc-link" data-sidebar="zero-auth">Zero Auth</a>.</p>
</blockquote>
<h2 class="heading heading-2 header-scroll"><div class="heading-anchor anchor waypoint" id="soft-descriptor"></div><div class="heading-text">Soft Descriptor</div><a aria-label="Skip link to Soft Descriptor" class="heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor" href="#soft-descriptor"></a></h2>
<p>Com essa ferramenta, o nome da sua loja aparecerá na fatura do cartão de crédito do seu cliente, <strong>diminuindo as chances de possíveis contestações por não reconhecimento da compra</strong>.</p>
<blockquote>
<p>Saiba mais em <a href="https://docs.cielo.com.br/ecommerce-cielo/reference/criar-pagamento-credito" target="_blank">Criar transação de cartão de crédito</a>.</p>
</blockquote>
<h2 class="heading heading-2 header-scroll"><div class="heading-anchor anchor waypoint" id="consulta-bin"></div><div class="heading-text">Consulta BIN</div><a aria-label="Skip link to Consulta BIN" class="heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor" href="#consulta-bin"></a></h2>
<p>Valide os dados do cartão preenchidos pelo cliente no momento da compra, como bandeira, banco, tipo do cartão, se é cartão estrangeiro, se é pessoa jurídica ou física.</p>
<blockquote>
<p>Saiba mais em <a href="/docs/consulta-bin" target="" title="" class="doc-link" data-sidebar="consulta-bin">Consulta BIN</a>.</p>
</blockquote>
<h2 class="heading heading-2 header-scroll"><div class="heading-anchor anchor waypoint" id="recorrência"></div><div class="heading-text">Recorrência</div><a aria-label="Skip link to Recorrência" class="heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor" href="#recorrência"></a></h2>
<p>Programe transações recorrentes para gerar cobranças periódicas sem a necessidade do portador do cartão participar do processo mais do que uma vez.</p>
<blockquote>
<p>Saiba mais em <a href="https://docs.cielo.com.br/ecommerce-cielo/docs/recorrencia" target="" title="">Sobre a Recorrência</a>.</p>
</blockquote>
<h2 class="heading heading-2 header-scroll"><div class="heading-anchor anchor waypoint" id="renova-fácil"></div><div class="heading-text">Renova Fácil</div><a aria-label="Skip link to Renova Fácil" class="heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor" href="#renova-fácil"></a></h2>
<p>Verifique se existe um novo número ou nova data de expiração de um cartão para os pagamentos recorrentes, evitando perda ou atrasos nos recebimentos.</p>
<blockquote>
<p>Saiba mais em <a href="https://docs.cielo.com.br/ecommerce-cielo/docs/renova-facil" target="" title="">Transação com Renova Fácil</a>.</p>
</blockquote></div><div align="center" class="Flex Flex_row " justify="between" style="--flex-gap:var(--md)"><div class="UpdatedAt"><p class="DateLine "><i class="icon icon-watch"></i>Updated<!-- --> <!-- -->7 months ago<!-- --> </p></div></div><hr class="NextStepsDivider"/><nav aria-label="Pagination Controls" class="PaginationControlsjDYuqu8pBMUy rm-Pagination"><a class="PaginationControls-link254uPEbaP92i PaginationControls-link_right5lsfuICZqXYk" aria-label="Next Page: Características da API E-commerce" href="/ecommerce-cielo/docs/caracteristicas-api-ecommerce"><div class="PaginationControls-text3qEXHZU00znD PaginationControls-text_right3EIfWubgRVVP">Características da API E-commerce</div><span class="PaginationControls-iconZbaZ3tgyhNmI icon-arrow-right2"></span></a></nav></section><section class="content-toc grid-25 "></section></div></article></div></main><footer aria-label="Status banner" class="Footer2U8XAPoGhlgO AppFooter rm-Banners"></footer><footer><div class="footer-banner-section">

utilities;\n@layer utilities;\n\u003c/style>\u003cp>A API E-commerce é uma solução completa de pagamento da Cielo, que conta com uma integração flexível e modular, alta conversão e segurança nas transações.\u003c/p>\n\u003cp>Com a API E-commerce Cielo é possível vender usando os principais meios de pagamentos do e-commerce, como cartões de crédito e débito, Pix, e-wallets, QRCode e boletos.\u003c/p>\n\u003cp>Além disso, a API E-commerce tem diversas ferramentas que podem ajudar no aumento da conversão:\u003c/p>\n\u003cspan aria-label=\"Expand image\" class=\"img lightbox closed\" role=\"button\" tabindex=\"0\">\u003cspan class=\"lightbox-inner\">\u003cimg alt=\"Ferramentas disponiveis na API E-commerce\" class=\"img img-align-center \" height=\"auto\" loading=\"lazy\" src=\"https://files.readme.io/d8e7e17-cielo-e-comm-readme.png\" title=\"\" width=\"auto\"/>\u003c/span>\u003c/span>\n\u003ch2 class=\"heading heading-2 header-scroll\">\u003cdiv class=\"heading-anchor anchor waypoint\" id=\"compra-com-um-clique\">\u003c/div>\u003cdiv class=\"heading-text\">Compra com um clique\u003c/div>\u003ca aria-label=\"Skip link to Compra com um clique\" class=\"heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor\" href=\"#compra-com-um-clique\">\u003c/a>\u003c/h2>\n\u003cp>Facilite o pagamento para o seu cliente, por meio do armazenamento seguro dos dados do cartão (tokenização) e possibilite compras futuras mais rápidas e fáceis, sem a necessidade de preencher os dados novamente.\u003c/p>\n\u003cblockquote>\n\u003cp>Saiba mais em \u003ca href=\"https://docs.cielo.com.br/ecommerce-cielo/docs/tokenizando-cartoes\" target=\"\" title=\"\">Tokenizando cartões\u003c/a>.\u003c/p>\n\u003c/blockquote>\n\u003ch2 class=\"heading heading-2 header-scroll\">\u003cdiv class=\"heading-anchor anchor waypoint\" id=\"zero-auth\">\u003c/div>\u003cdiv class=\"heading-text\">Zero Auth\u003c/div>\u003ca aria-label=\"Skip link to Zero Auth\" class=\"heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor\" href=\"#zero-auth\">\u003c/a>\u003c/h2>\n\u003cp>Antes de enviar um pagamento para autorização junto ao banco emissor, \u003cstrong>verifique se o cartão é válido ou não\u003c/strong> , sem comprometer nenhum valor na fatura do seu cliente.\u003c/p>\n\u003cblockquote>\n\u003cp>Saiba mais em \u003ca href=\"/docs/zero-auth\" target=\"\" title=\"\" class=\"doc-link\" data-sidebar=\"zero-auth\">Zero Auth\u003c/a>.\u003c/p>\n\u003c/blockquote>\n\u003ch2 class=\"heading heading-2 header-scroll\">\u003cdiv class=\"heading-anchor anchor waypoint\" id=\"soft-descriptor\">\u003c/div>\u003cdiv class=\"heading-text\">Soft Descriptor\u003c/div>\u003ca aria-label=\"Skip link to Soft Descriptor\" class=\"heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor\" href=\"#soft-descriptor\">\u003c/a>\u003c/h2>\n\u003cp>Com essa ferramenta, o nome da sua loja aparecerá na fatura do cartão de crédito do seu cliente, \u003cstrong>diminuindo as chances de possíveis contestações por não reconhecimento da compra\u003c/strong>.\u003c/p>\n\u003cblockquote>\n\u003cp>Saiba mais em \u003ca href=\"https://docs.cielo.com.br/ecommerce-cielo/reference/criar-pagamento-credito\" target=\"_blank\">Criar transação de cartão de crédito\u003c/a>.\u003c/p>\n\u003c/blockquote>\n\u003ch2 class=\"heading heading-2 header-scroll\">\u003cdiv class=\"heading-anchor anchor waypoint\" id=\"consulta-bin\">\u003c/div>\u003cdiv class=\"heading-text\">Consulta BIN\u003c/div>\u003ca aria-label=\"Skip link to Consulta BIN\" class=\"heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor\" href=\"#consulta-bin\">\u003c/a>\u003c/h2>\n\u003cp>Valide os dados do cartão preenchidos pelo cliente no momento da compra, como bandeira, banco, tipo do cartão, se é cartão estrangeiro, se é pessoa jurídica ou física.\u003c/p>\n\u003cblockquote>\n\u003cp>Saiba mais em \u003ca href=\"/docs/consulta-bin\" target=\"\" title=\"\" class=\"doc-link\" data-sidebar=\"consulta-bin\">Consulta BIN\u003c/a>.\u003c/p>\n\u003c/blockquote>\n\u003ch2 class=\"heading heading-2 header-scroll\">\u003cdiv class=\"heading-anchor anchor waypoint\" id=\"recorrência\">\u003c/div>\u003cdiv class=\"heading-text\">Recorrência\u003c/div>\u003ca aria-label=\"Skip link to Recorrência\" class=\"heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor\" href=\"#recorrência\">\u003c/a>\u003c/h2>\n\u003cp>Programe transações recorrentes para gerar cobranças periódicas sem a necessidade do portador do cartão participar do processo mais do que uma vez.\u003c/p>\n\u003cblockquote>\n\u003cp>Saiba mais em \u003ca href=\"https://docs.cielo.com.br/ecommerce-cielo/docs/recorrencia\" target=\"\" title=\"\">Sobre a Recorrência\u003c/a>.\u003c/p>\n\u003c/blockquote>\n\u003ch2 class=\"heading heading-2 header-scroll\">\u003cdiv class=\"heading-anchor anchor waypoint\" id=\"renova-fácil\">\u003c/div>\u003cdiv class=\"heading-text\">Renova Fácil\u003c/div>\u003ca aria-label=\"Skip link to Renova Fácil\" class=\"heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor\" href=\"#renova-fácil\">\u003c/a>\u003c/h2>\n\u003cp>Verifique se existe um novo número ou nova data de expiração de um cartão para os pagamentos recorrentes, evitando perda ou atrasos nos recebimentos.\u003c/p>\n\u003cblockquote>\n\u003cp>Saiba mais em \u003ca href=\"https://docs.cielo.com.br/ecommerce-cielo/docs/renova-facil\" target=\"\" title=\"\">Transação com Renova Fácil\u003c/a>.\u003c/p>\n\u003c/blockquote>","css":"/*! tailwindcss v4.1.17 | MIT License | https://tailwindcss.com */\n@layer theme, base, components, utilities;\n@layer Normalize: lowercase, strip diacritics, convert NBSP to space, remove punctuation, collapse spaces\n  const key = (s) => (s || \"\")\n    .replace(/\\u00A0/g, \" \")\n    .normalize(\"NFKD\").replace(/[\\u0300-\\u036f]/g, \"\")\n    .toLowerCase()\n    .replace(/[()\\-–—[\\]{}.,:;!?]/g, \" \")\n    .replace(/\\s+/g, \" \")\n    .trim();\n\n  const targetKeys = new Set(targets.map(key));\n\n  function findAndToggle(root = document) {\n    const filter = root.querySelector(\".rm-SearchFilter, [class*='SearchProjectsFilter']\");\n    if (!filter) return false;\n\n    const spans = filter.querySelectorAll(\".Toggle-label, .Toggle-label_md, [class*='Toggle-label']\");\n    for (const span of spans) {\n      const txtKey = key(span.textContent);\n      if (targetKeys.has(txtKey)) {\n        const label = span.closest(\"label\");\n        const input = label?.querySelector('input[type=\"checkbox\"]');\n        // Try clicking the label (often wired), then ensure input is checked and notify React\n        if (label) label.click();\n        if (input && !input.checked) {\n          input.click();\n          input.dispatchEvent(new Event(\"change\", { bubbles: true }));\n        }\n        return true;\n      }\n    }\n    return false;\n  }\n\n  // Retry loop inside the modal (handles late population)\n  function toggleWithRetries(root) {\n    const started = Date.now();\n    const attempt = () => {\n      if (findAndToggle(root)) return;\n      if (Date.now() - started > 8000) return; // stop after 8s\n      setTimeout(attempt, 120);\n    };\n    attempt();\n  }\n\n  // Watch for modal mount, then run bounded retries\n  let lastModal = null;\n  const mo = new MutationObserver(muts => {\n    for (const m of muts) {\n      for (const n of m.addedNodes) {\n        if (!(n instanceof HTMLElement)) continue;\n        const modal = n.matches?.(\".rm-SearchModal, [class*='SearchModal']\") ? n : n.querySelector?.(\".rm-SearchModal, [class*='SearchModal']\");\n        if (modal && modal !== lastModal) {\n          lastModal = modal;\n          setTimeout(() => toggleWithRetries(modal), 50);\n        }\n      }\n    }\n  });\n  mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });\n\n  // Safety: if already open on load\n  window.addEventListener(\"load\", () => setTimeout(() => toggleWithRetries(document), 200));\n})();\n\n\n\n\n// Restringir a busca ao projeto atual\n\nwindow.addEventListener(\"load\", (event) => {\n    const clickExample = () => {\n        // Find all labels within the refinement label text matches \"Project Name\"\n            if (label.textContent.trim() === \"Cielo E-commerce\") {\n                // Find the checkbox inside the label and click it\n                const checkbox = label.querySelector('input[type=\"checkbox\"]');\n                if (checkbox) {\n                    checkbox.click();\n                    clearInterval(interval);\n                    break; // Stop the loop once the desired checkbox is clicked\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    };\n\n    const interval = setInterval(clickExample, 500);\n});\n\n// Function to replace  let node;\n  while (node = walker.nextNode()) {\n    node.nodeValue = node.nodeValue.replace(/required/g, 'obrigatório');\n  }\n}\n\n// Function to monitor for new elements with classes that start mutations.forEach((mutation) => {\n      mutation.addedNodes.forEach((node) => {\n        if (node.nodeType === Node.ELEMENT_NODE && node.matches('[class^=\"Param-required\"]')) {\n          // If a new element with a class starting with \"Param-required\" is added, replace the word inside it\n          replaceWordInElement(node);\n        }\n        // Check for child nodes that may also need updating\n        node.querySelectorAll && node.querySelectorAll('[class^=\"Param-required\"]').forEach(child => {\n          replaceWordInElement(child);\n        });\n      });\n    });\n  });\n\n  // Start observing the entire document for changes\n  observer.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });\n}\n\n// Run the replacement function initially for any existing currentPath = window.location.pathname;\n  const isEnglishPage =\n    currentPath === '/english' ||\n    currentPath === '/english/';\n  const isSplitEnglishPage = currentPath.startsWith('/split/v1.0-en/');\n  const isAtendimentoProject =\n    currentPath === '/atendimento' ||\n    currentPath === '/atendimento/' ||\n    currentPath.startsWith('/atendimento/');\n  const validPaths = ['/', '/english', '/english/'];\n\n  if (!validPaths.includes(currentPath) && !isSplitEnglishPage && !isAtendimentoProject) {\n    return;\n  }\n\n  const portugueseFilters = [\n    \"Checkout e Link de Pagamento\",\n    \"Cielo E-commerce\",\n    \"Conectores E-commerce\",\n    \"Gateway de Pagamento\",\n    \"Risco\",\n    \"Split\"\n  ];\n\n  const englishFilters = [\n    \"Checkout and Link de Pagamento EN\",\n    \"Cielo E-commerce API EN\",\n    \"Gateway API EN\",\n    \"Risk Management EN\",\n    \"Split\",\n    \"Cielo E-commerce (EN)\"\n  ];\n\n  const atendimentoFilters = [\n    \"Atendimento E-commerce Cielo\"\n  ];\n\n  const splitEnglishPathPrefix = \"/split/v1.0-en/\";\n  const filtersToKeep = isAtendimentoProject\n    ? atendimentoFilters\n    : isSplitEnglishPage\n      ? [\"Split\"]\n      : isEnglishPage\n        ? englishFilters\n        : portugueseFilters;\n\n  const key = (s) => (s || \"\")\n    .replace(/\\u00A0/g, \" \")\n    .normalize(\"NFKD\").replace(/[\\u0300-\\u036f]/g, \"\")\n    .toLowerCase()\n    .replace(/[()\\-–—[\\]{}.,:;!?]/g, \" \")\n    .replace(/\\s+/g, \" \")\n    .trim();\n\n  const keepKeys = new Set(filtersToKeep.map(key));\n\n  function setCheckboxState(input, shouldBeChecked) {\n    if (!input) return;\n\n    if (input.checked !== shouldBeChecked) {\n      input.click();\n      input.dispatchEvent(new Event(\"input\", { bubbles: true }));\n      input.dispatchEvent(new Event(\"change\", { bubbles: true }));\n    }\n  }\n\n  function configureSearchFilters(root = document) {\n    const filterAside =\n      root.querySelector(\"aside.rm-SearchFilter\") ||\n      document.querySelector(\"aside.rm-SearchFilter\");\n\n    if (!filterAside) return false;\n\n    const items = filterAside.querySelectorAll(\"li.rm-SearchFilter-list-item, ol li\");\n    if (!items.length) return false;\n\n    items.forEach((item) => {\n      const label = item.querySelector(\"label\");\n      const input = item.querySelector('input[type=\"checkbox\"]');\n      const textEl = item.querySelector(\".Toggle-label\");\n      const text = key(textEl ? textEl.textContent : label ? label.textContent : \"\");\n\n      if (!input || !text) return;\n\n      const shouldKeep = keepKeys.has(text);\n\n      item.style.display = shouldKeep ? \"\" : \"none\";\n      setCheckboxState(input, shouldKeep);\n    });\n\n    return true;\n  }\n\n  function resultPathAllowed(anchor) {\n    if (!isSplitEnglishPage || !anchor) return true;\n\n    try {\n      const url = new URL(anchor.getAttribute(\"href\"), window.location.origin);\n      return url.pathname === splitEnglishPathPrefix.slice(0, -1) ||\n        url.pathname.startsWith(splitEnglishPathPrefix);\n    } catch (_error) {\n      return false;\n    }\n  }\n\n  function configureSearchResults(root = document) {\n    if (!isSplitEnglishPage) return false;\n\n    const containers = root.matches?.(\"[class*='SearchResult'], [class*='SearchResults']\")\n      ? [root]\n      : Array.from(root.querySelectorAll?.(\"[class*='SearchResult'], [class*='SearchResults']\") || []);\n\n    if (!containers.length) return false;\n\n    let foundResultLink = false;\n\n    containers.forEach((container) => {\n      const links = container.querySelectorAll?.(\"a[href]\") || [];\n\n      links.forEach((link) => {\n        const href = link.getAttribute(\"href\") || \"\";\n        if (!href || href.startsWith(\"#\") || href.startsWith(\"mailto:\") || href.startsWith(\"tel:\")) {\n          return;\n        }\n\n        const resultItem =\n          link.closest(\"li\") ||\n          link.closest(\"article\") ||\n          link.closest(\"[class*='SearchResult']\");\n\n        if (!resultItem) return;\n\n        foundResultLink = true;\n        resultItem.style.display = resultPathAllowed(link) ? \"\" : \"none\";\n      });\n    });\n\n    return foundResultLink;\n  }\n\n  function runWithRetries(root = document) {\n    const started = Date.now();\n\n    const attempt = () => {\n      const filtersOk = configureSearchFilters(root);\n      const resultsOk = configureSearchResults(root);\n      const ok = isSplitEnglishPage ? (filtersOk || resultsOk) : filtersOk;\n      if (ok) return;\n      if (Date.now() - started > 10000) return;\n      setTimeout(attempt, 200);\n    };\n\n    setTimeout(attempt, 700);\n  }\n\n  function observeSearchUi() {\n    if (!document.body) {\n      setTimeout(observeSearchUi, 50);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    const observer = new MutationObserver((mutations) => {\n      for (const mutation of mutations) {\n        for (const node of mutation.addedNodes) {\n          if (!(node instanceof HTMLElement)) continue;\n\n          const searchContainer =\n            node.matches?.(\"[class*='SuperHubSearch-container']\")\n              ? node\n              : node.querySelector?.(\"[class*='SuperHubSearch-container']\");\n\n          const filterAside =\n            node.matches?.(\"aside.rm-SearchFilter\")\n              ? node\n              : node.querySelector?.(\"aside.rm-SearchFilter\");\n\n          const searchResults =\n            node.matches?.(\"[class*='SearchResult'], [class*='SearchResults']\")\n              ? node\n              : node.querySelector?.(\"[class*='SearchResult'], [class*='SearchResults']\");\n\n          if (searchContainer || filterAside || searchResults) {\n            runWithRetries(searchContainer || filterAside || searchResults || document);\n          }\n        }\n      }\n    });\n\n    observer.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });\n  }\n\n  document.addEventListener(\"DOMContentLoaded\", () => {\n    observeSearchUi();\n    runWithRetries(document);\n const started = Date.now();\n    const attempt = () => {\n      if (findAndToggle(root)) return;\n      if (Date.now() - started > 8000) return; // stop after 8s\n      setTimeout(attempt, 120);\n    };\n    attempt();\n  }\n\n  // Watch for modal mount, then run bounded retries\n  let lastModal = null;\n  const mo = new MutationObserver(muts => {\n    for (const m of muts) {\n      for (const n [class*='SearchModal']\");\n        if (modal && modal !== lastModal) {\n          lastModal = modal;\n          setTimeout(() => toggleWithRetries(modal), 50);\n        }\n      }\n    }\n  });\n  mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });\n\n  // Safety: if already open on load\n  window.addEventListener(\"load\", () => setTimeout(() => toggleWithRetries(document), .normalize(\"NFKD\").replace(/[\\u0300-\\u036f]/g, \"\")\n    .toLowerCase()\n    .replace(/[()\\-–—[\\]{}.,:;!?]/g, \" \")\n    .replace(/\\s+/g, \" \")\n    .trim();\n\n  const targetKeys = new Set(targets.map(key));\n\n  function findAndToggle(root = document) {\n    const filter = root.querySelector(\".rm-SearchFilter, [class*='SearchProjectsFilter']\");\n    if (!filter) return false;\n\n    const spans = filter.querySelectorAll(\".Toggle-label, .Toggle-label_md, [class*='Toggle-label']\");\n    for (const span of spans) {\n      const txtKey = key(span.textContent);\n      if (targetKeys.has(txtKey)) {\n        const label = span.closest(\"label\");\n        const input = label?.querySelector('input[type=\"checkbox\"]');\n        // Try clicking the label (often wired), then ensure input is checked and notify React\n        if (label) label.click();\n        if (input && !input.checked) {\n          input.click();\n          input.dispatchEvent(new Event(\"change\", { bubbles: true }));\n        }\n        return true;\n      }\n    }\n    return false;\n  }\n\n  // Retry loop inside the modal (handles late population)\n  function toggleWithRetries(root) {\n    const started = Date.now();\n    const attempt = () => {\n      if (findAndToggle(root)) return;\n      if (Date.now() - started > 8000) return; // stop after 8s\n      setTimeout(attempt, 120);\n    };\n    attempt();\n  }\n\n  // Watch for modal mount, then run bounded retries\n  let lastModal = null;\n  const mo = new MutationObserver(muts => {\n    for (const m of muts) {\n      for (const n of m.addedNodes) {\n        if (!(n instanceof HTMLElement)) continue;\n        const modal = n.matches?.(\".rm-SearchModal, [class*='SearchModal']\") ? n : n.querySelector?.(\".rm-SearchModal, [class*='SearchModal']\");\n        if (modal && modal !== lastModal) {\n          lastModal = modal;\n          setTimeout(() => toggleWithRetries(modal), 50);\n        }\n      }\n    }\n  });\n  mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });\n\n  // Safety: if already open on load\n  window.addEventListener(\"load\", () => setTimeout(() => toggleWithRetries(document), 200));\n})();\n\n\n\n\n// Restringir a busca ao projeto atual\n\nwindow.addEventListener(\"load\", (event) => {\n    const clickExample = () => {\n        // Find all labels within the refinement break; // Stop the loop once the desired checkbox is clicked\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    };\n\n    const interval = setInterval(clickExample, 500);\n});\n\n// Function to replace  let node;\n  while (node = walker.nextNode()) {\n    node.nodeValue = node.nodeValue.replace(/required/g, 'obrigatório');\n  }\n}\n\n// Function to monitor for new elements with classes that start mutations.forEach((mutation) => {\n      mutation.addedNodes.forEach((node) => {\n        if (node.nodeType === Node.ELEMENT_NODE && node.matches('[class^=\"Param-required\"]')) {\n          // If a updating\n        node.querySelectorAll && node.querySelectorAll('[class^=\"Param-required\"]').forEach(child => {\n          replaceWordInElement(child);\n        });\n      });\n    });\n  });\n\n  // Start observing the entire document for changes\n  observer.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });\n}\n\n// Run the replacement function initially for any existing E-commerce\"];\n\n  const targets = window.SEARCH_PROJECT_LABELS.map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);\n\n  // Normalize: lowercase, strip diacritics, convert NBSP to space, remove punctuation, collapse spaces\n  const key = (s) => (s || \"\")\n    .replace(/\\u00A0/g, \" \")\n    .normalize(\"NFKD\").replace(/[\\u0300-\\u036f]/g, \"\")\n    .toLowerCase()\n    .replace(/[()\\-–—[\\]{}.,:;!?]/g, \" \")\n    .replace(/\\s+/g, \" \")\n    .trim();\n\n  const targetKeys = new Set(targets.map(key));\n\n  function findAndToggle(root = document) {\n    const filter = root.querySelector(\".rm-SearchFilter, [class*='SearchProjectsFilter']\");\n    if (!filter) return false;\n\n    const spans = filter.querySelectorAll(\".Toggle-label, .Toggle-label_md, [class*='Toggle-label']\");\n    for (const span of spans) {\n      const txtKey = key(span.textContent);\n      if (targetKeys.has(txtKey)) {\n        const label = span.closest(\"label\");\n        const input = label?.querySelector('input[type=\"checkbox\"]');\n        // Try clicking the label (often wired), then ensure input is checked and notify React\n        if (label) label.click();\n        if (input && !input.checked) {\n          input.click();\n          input.dispatchEvent(new Event(\"change\", { bubbles: true }));\n        }\n        return true;\n      }\n    }\n    return false;\n  }\n\n  // Retry loop inside the modal (handles late population)\n  function toggleWithRetries(root) {\n    const started = Date.now();\n    const attempt = () => {\n      if (findAndToggle(root)) return;\n      if (Date.now() - started > 8000) return; // stop after 8s\n      setTimeout(attempt, 120);\n    };\n    attempt();\n  }\n\n  // Watch for modal mount, then run bounded retries\n  let lastModal = null;\n  const mo = new MutationObserver(muts => {\n    for (const m of muts) {\n      for (const n of m.addedNodes) {\n        if (!(n instanceof HTMLElement)) continue;\n        const modal = n.matches?.(\".rm-SearchModal, [class*='SearchModal']\") ? n : n.querySelector?.(\".rm-SearchModal, [class*='SearchModal']\");\n        if (modal && modal !== lastModal) {\n          lastModal = modal;\n          setTimeout(() => toggleWithRetries(modal), 50);\n        }\n      }\n    }\n  });\n  mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });\n\n  // Safety: if already open on load\n  window.addEventListener(\"load\", () => setTimeout(() => toggleWithRetries(document), 200));\n})();\n\n\n\n\n// Restringir a busca ao projeto atual\n\nwindow.addEventListener(\"load\", (event) => {\n    const clickExample = () => {\n        // Find all labels within the refinement list\n        const labels = document.querySelectorAll(\"[class*='RefinementList'] label\");\n\n        // Iterate over each label\n        for (let label of labels) {\n            // Check if the label text matches \"Project Name\"\n            if (label.textContent.trim() === \"Cielo E-commerce\") {\n                // Find the checkbox inside the label and click it\n                const checkbox = label.querySelector('input[type=\"checkbox\"]');\n                if (checkbox) {\n                    checkbox.click();\n                    clearInterval(interval);\n                    break; // Stop the loop once the desired checkbox is clicked\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    };\n\n    const interval = setInterval(clickExample, 500);\n});\n\n// Function to replace the word \"required\" with \"obrigatório\" within specific elements\nfunction replaceWordInElement(element) {\n  const walker = document.createTreeWalker(element, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT, null, false);\n  let node;\n  while (node = walker.nextNode()) {\n    node.nodeValue = node.nodeValue.replace(/required/g, 'obrigatório');\n  }\n}\n\n// Function to monitor for new elements with classes that start with \"Param-required\"\nfunction monitorForRequiredClasses() {\n  // Create a MutationObserver to watch for changes in the DOM\n  const observer = new MutationObserver((mutations) => {\n    mutations.forEach((mutation) => {\n      mutation.addedNodes.forEach((node) => {\n        if (node.nodeType === Node.ELEMENT_NODE && node.matches('[class^=\"Param-required\"]')) {\n          // If a new element with a class starting with \"Param-required\" is added, replace the word inside it\n          replaceWordInElement(node);\n        }\n        // Check for child nodes that may also need updating\n        node.querySelectorAll && node.querySelectorAll('[class^=\"Param-required\"]').forEach(child => {\n          replaceWordInElement(child);\n        });\n      });\n    });\n  });\n\n  // Start observing the entire document for changes\n  observer.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });\n}\n\n// Run the replacement function initially for any existing content\nwindow.onload = function() {\n  document.querySelectorAll('[class^=\"Param-required\"]').forEach(element => {\n    replaceWordInElement(element);\n  });\n  // Start monitoring for new elements\n  monitorForRequiredClasses();\n};\n\n// Traduzir \"Search\" para \"Busca\" e \"Did this page help you\" para \"Essa página foi útil?\"\n\n$(window).on('pageLoad', function(e, state) {\n\n  document.querySelector('.rm-SearchToggle-placeholder').textContent = 'Buscar';\n  \n  setTimeout(function() {\n\n    const helpfulTextElement = document.querySelector('.PageThumbs-helpful');\n\n    if (helpfulTextElement) {\n      helpfulTextElement.childNodes.forEach(node => {\n        if (node.nodeType === Node.TEXT_NODE && node.nodeValue.trim() === 'Did this page help you?') {\n          node.nodeValue = 'Essa página foi útil?';\n        }\n      });\n    }\n\n    const yesButton = document.querySelector('.PageThumbs-cta .Dropdown:nth-of-type(1) button span');\n    const noButton = (() => {
  // Set one or more exact targets for THIS site:
  window.SEARCH_PROJECT_LABELS = window.SEARCH_PROJECT_LABELS || ["Cielo E-commerce"];

  const targets = window.SEARCH_PROJECT_LABELS.map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);

  // Normalize: lowercase, strip diacritics, convert NBSP to space, remove punctuation, collapse spaces
  const key = (s) => (s || "")
    .replace(/\u00A0/g, " ")
    .normalize("NFKD").replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, "")
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/[()\-–—[\]{}.,:;!?]/g, " ")
    .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
    .trim();

  const targetKeys = new Set(targets.map(key));

  function findAndToggle(root = document) {
    const filter = root.querySelector(".rm-SearchFilter, [class*='SearchProjectsFilter']");
    if (!filter) return false;

    const spans = filter.querySelectorAll(".Toggle-label, .Toggle-label_md, [class*='Toggle-label']");
    for (const span of spans) {
      const txtKey = key(span.textContent);
      if (targetKeys.has(txtKey)) {
        const label = span.closest("label");
        const input = label?.querySelector('input[type="checkbox"]');
        // Try clicking the label (often wired), then ensure input is checked and notify React
        if (label) label.click();
        if (input && !input.checked) {
          input.click();
          input.dispatchEvent(new Event("change", { bubbles: true }));
        }
        return true;
      }
    }
    return false;
  }

  // Retry loop inside the modal (handles late population)
  function toggleWithRetries(root) {
    const started = Date.now();
    const attempt = () => {
      if (findAndToggle(root)) return;
      if (Date.now() - started > 8000) return; // stop after 8s
      setTimeout(attempt, 120);
    };
    attempt();
  }

  // Watch for modal mount, then run bounded retries
  let lastModal = null;
  const mo = new MutationObserver(muts => {
    for (const m of muts) {
      for (const n of m.addedNodes) {
        if (!(n instanceof HTMLElement)) continue;
        const modal = n.matches?.(".rm-SearchModal, [class*='SearchModal']") ? n : n.querySelector?.(".rm-SearchModal, [class*='SearchModal']");
        if (modal && modal !== lastModal) {
          lastModal = modal;
          setTimeout(() => toggleWithRetries(modal), 50);
        }
      }
    }
  });
  mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });

  // Safety: if already open on load
  window.addEventListener("load", () => setTimeout(() => toggleWithRetries(document), 200));
})();




// Restringir a busca ao projeto atual

window.addEventListener("load", (event) => {
    const clickExample = () => {
        // Find all labels within the refinement list
        const labels = document.querySelectorAll("[class*='RefinementList'] label");

        // Iterate over each label
        for (let label of labels) {
            // Check if the label text matches "Project Name"
            if (label.textContent.trim() === "Cielo E-commerce") {
                // Find the checkbox inside the label and click it
                const checkbox = label.querySelector('input[type="checkbox"]');
                if (checkbox) {
                    checkbox.click();
                    clearInterval(interval);
                    break; // Stop the loop once the desired checkbox is clicked
                }
            }
        }
    };

    const interval = setInterval(clickExample, 500);
});

// Function to replace the word "required" with "obrigatório" within specific elements
function replaceWordInElement(element) {
  const walker = document.createTreeWalker(element, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT, null, false);
  let node;
  while (node = walker.nextNode()) {
    node.nodeValue = node.nodeValue.replace(/required/g, 'obrigatório');
  }
}

// Function to monitor for new elements with classes that start with "Param-required"
function monitorForRequiredClasses() {
  // Create a MutationObserver to watch for changes in the DOM
  const observer = new MutationObserver((mutations) => {
    mutations.forEach((mutation) => {
      mutation.addedNodes.forEach((node) => {
        if (node.nodeType === Node.ELEMENT_NODE && node.matches('[class^="Param-required"]')) {
          // If a new element with a class starting with "Param-required" is added, replace the word inside it
          replaceWordInElement(node);
        }
        // Check for child nodes that may also need updating
        node.querySelectorAll && node.querySelectorAll('[class^="Param-required"]').forEach(child => {
          replaceWordInElement(child);
        });
      });
    });
  });

  // Start observing the entire document for changes
  observer.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
}

// Run the replacement function initially for any existing content
window.onload = function() {
  document.querySelectorAll('[class^="Param-required"]').forEach(element => {
    replaceWordInElement(element);
  });
  // Start monitoring for new elements
  monitorForRequiredClasses();
};

// Traduzir "Search" para "Busca" e "Did this page help you" para "Essa página foi útil?"

$(window).on('pageLoad', function(e, state) {

  document.querySelector('.rm-SearchToggle-placeholder').textContent = 'Buscar';
  
  setTimeout(function() {

    const helpfulTextElement = document.querySelector('.PageThumbs-helpful');

    if (helpfulTextElement) {
      helpfulTextElement.childNodes.forEach(node => {
        if (node.nodeType === Node.TEXT_NODE && node.nodeValue.trim() === 'Did this page help you?') {
          node.nodeValue = 'Essa página foi útil?';
        }
      });
    }

    const yesButton = document.querySelector('.PageThumbs-cta .Dropdown:nth-of-type(1) button span');
    const noButton = document.querySelector('.PageThumbs-cta .Dropdown:nth-of-type(2) button span');

    if (yesButton) yesButton.textContent = 'Sim';
    if (noButton) noButton.textContent = 'Não';
    
  }, 500);

});
